rationale.claim: At q=1 over an algebraically closed characteristic-p field for EVERY odd prime p, lambda=(2p-2,1),r=2p-1 has simple source-FI-convention Young module of dimension2p-2 while its polynomial injective I_n(lambda) is nonprojective for EVERY n>=2. The stronger index-set proposal is also contradicted via its sufficient-projectivity implication.
